title: Home single-pass Maintenance criticalWorkTotal (eliminate second getAll)
features: MaintenanceService.getAll accepts includeCriticalWorkTotal and returns exact active high|critical count before pagination
Home WorkspaceService uses one Maintenance getAll for active pool + Critical Work (no separate high_or_critical pageSize 1 request)
performance: Removes duplicate Maintenance register scan on /operations core path

deploymentSemantics.deploymentRequired: Pack intent: a new Web App deploy is required to apply this source release when cutting from the repo. Not a live deployment status flag.
deploymentSemantics.appsScriptRedeploy: Required — replace MaintenanceService.gs and cut a new Web App version.

notes: Deploy must include updated MaintenanceService.gs, then a new Web App version.
Until redeployed, Home Critical Work stays null (fail-closed) while pool rows may still load if an older getAll ignores the flag.
Additive getAll flag only; default list/UI getAll unchanged.
high_or_critical filter retained for non-Home callers.
